entries.note: Recorded the day the shipment is booked, before or after its acceptance: a notice of the shipment, not a movement. A repeat after a physical scan keeps that scan's stage.
Acceptance at an agency. One placed at the web channel (WEB) is the online booking and registers the shipment.
The agency handles an incident, such as a round that did not deliver, and warns of a delay; an arranged delivery follows.
A delivery arrangement after an incident, such as a new day; delivery resumes.
The parcel is redirected to a NACEX pickup point; the point code after the label is dropped.
The delivery address changed and the parcel is rerouted.
The delivering agency asks to be contacted before it delivers.
An incident closed without success, for instance by a return or a request to contact the agency.
An administrative note such as a message sent to the recipient or the attempt limit; it keeps the stage of the scan before it.
